stimulus.title: Drill B1 · Placa / aviso · alvo: 2 min
stimulus.content:
TEXT: Sign at a nature reserve trailhead

RIDGELINE TRAIL: PLEASE READ BEFORE ENTERING

• Trail open sunrise to sunset. Overnight camping is not permitted anywhere on the reserve.
• Dogs welcome on a leash no longer than 6 feet. The upper loop (marked in red) is closed to dogs from April 1 to July 15 to protect ground-nesting birds.
• No bicycles. E-bikes and mobility scooters are exempt from this rule.
• Pack out all trash. There are no trash cans beyond this point.

prompt: A visitor with a dog on May 20 may walk:

options.B: on all trails except the upper loop
options.D: nowhere, because dogs are banned in summer

explanation: Cães de coleira são permitidos; o upper loop é fechado a cães de 1/abr a 15/jul, e 20 de maio cai nesse período → todas as trilhas exceto o upper loop. (A) ignora a restrição; (C) inverte; (D) exagera: cães não são banidos, só do upper loop.

stimulus.title: Drill B3 · E-mail formal · alvo: 3 min
stimulus.content:
TEXT: Email from a course coordinator

Subject: Re: Request to submit Assignment 2 late

Dear Bruna,

Thank you for letting me know about your situation in advance rather than after the deadline. I'm sorry to hear you've been unwell.

Our department policy does not allow me to grant an extension without a doctor's note. If you're able to provide one, I can extend your deadline to next Monday. If not, I can still accept the assignment up to 48 hours late, though the standard 10% late penalty would apply in that case.

Please let me know which option you'd prefer by Thursday so I can update the system.

Best regards,
Dr. Okafor

prompt: What is the main purpose of this email?

options.B: To explain the options available and ask Bruna to choose
options.C: To inform Bruna that her assignment is now overdue
options.D: To apologize for a mistake the department made

explanation: O e-mail lista duas opções (com ou sem atestado) e pede que Bruna escolha até quinta. (A) não recusa, oferece alternativas; (C) o trabalho ainda não está atrasado; (D) não houve erro do departamento.

stimulus.title: Drill B4 · Horário / tabela · alvo: 2 min
stimulus.content:
TEXT: Shuttle timetable notice

CAMPUS ↔ STATION SHUTTLE

Departs Campus Gate: on the hour and at half past, 7:00–19:00, Mon–Fri. Departs Station: at quarter past and quarter to, same times. Journey time: approximately 20 minutes.

The half-past and quarter-to services do not run after 17:00: the last half-past departure from Campus Gate is at 16:30. On weekends and holidays, shuttles leave both stops on the hour only.

prompt: A student wants to leave Campus Gate on a Tuesday at 17:30. On that day there is:

options.A: no 17:30 service — after 17:00 the shuttle leaves on the hour only
options.B: a 17:30 service that arrives at the station around 17:50
options.C: a shuttle only if it is a holiday
options.D: a 17:30 service that takes about 45 minutes

explanation: A nota de rodapé é explícita: "the last half-past departure from Campus Gate is at 16:30" e, depois das 17:00, o serviço é "on the hour only". Logo, não existe 17:30 na terça-feira. Este item treina a leitura da nota de rodapé: quem responde (B) leu só a linha principal e ignorou a exceção.

stimulus.title: Drill B5 · Post de rede social · alvo: 3 min
stimulus.content:
TEXT: A social media post from a local bakery

🥐 Riverside Bakery · Posted 2 hours ago

Big news, everyone! Starting next Tuesday, we're extending our weekday hours — open at 6:30 AM instead of 7:00 AM, so early risers can grab their coffee and croissants before work. 🌅

Quick heads-up though: because of the earlier opening, our weekday sourdough batch will now go into the oven the night before instead of first thing in the morning. It'll still be baked fresh daily, just on a slightly different schedule — so if you're used to grabbing a loaf warm out of the oven at 8 AM, you'll now find it ready on the shelf as soon as we open. Come say hi and let us know what you think of the new hours!

Weekend hours are unchanged (8 AM–3 PM, same as always).

prompt: What is the main purpose of this post?

options.A: To announce that the bakery is closing early on weekdays
options.B: To inform customers about a change to weekday opening hours
options.C: To apologize for a delay in the sourdough baking schedule
options.D: To advertise a new type of bread

explanation: O post inteiro gira em torno de um anúncio: abrir mais cedo nos dias de semana. (A) inverte; (C) não pede desculpas; (D) nenhum pão novo.
